article.title: Red Sea rerouting strands wiring-harness containers; Maruti halts two Manesar lines
article.text: Maruti Suzuki India suspended production on two of its Manesar assembly lines after wiring-harness containers routed around the Cape of Good Hope arrived eighteen days late, exhausting the buffer stock the company had built through December. The plant runs on a two-day inventory model for harnesses, which are model-specific and cannot be substituted between platforms. The company said it expects to recover the lost volume within the quarter through additional Saturday shifts. Component suppliers on the affected programmes will see the same volume gap in their own dispatch schedules before the recovery shifts begin. The same rerouting has spiked spot freight rates on the Cape route as capacity tightens.

shocks.label: Shipping route disruption
shocks.mechanism: Rerouting around the Cape adds roughly a fortnight of transit, which breaks just-in-time inventory models that hold days rather than weeks of cover

shocks.label: Component supply gap
shocks.mechanism: A stopped assembly programme removes the offtake its component suppliers were scheduled to dispatch against, propagating the volume gap one link down the chain

companies.name: Maruti Suzuki India
companies.mechanism: Two assembly lines are stopped for want of a model-specific harness with only two days of cover, so the volume gap is booked before the recovery shifts can begin
companies.rationale: Company-confirmed line stoppage caused directly by the rerouting delay
negative_channels: assembly line stoppage and lost volume

children.mechanism: The halted Manesar programmes are themselves the transmission point into the component supply chain that feeds them

companies.name: Samvardhana Motherson International
companies.mechanism: Dispatch schedules into the halted Manesar programmes stop with the lines, so the India wiring-harness division books the same volume gap one link down the chain
companies.rationale: Documented harness supplier to the exact vehicle programmes that stopped
negative_channels: dispatch volume gap on the halted programmes

companies.name: Great Eastern Shipping Company
companies.mechanism: Cape rerouting tightens available tonnage on the route and lifts spot freight rates, which raises revenue per voyage on owned spare capacity, while the same rerouting adds fuel days and war-risk insurance cost per voyage
companies.rationale: Has uncommitted owned tonnage that can be chartered into the tightened route, but also runs its own vessels through the same longer, costlier routing
positive_channels: higher spot freight rate on chartered-out spare capacity
negative_channels: higher fuel-day and insurance cost on its own rerouted voyages
